work.author: Catholic Church
work.description: The postconciliar Roman Rite book of readings for Mass, first published in 1969 and issued in a second Latin typical edition in 1981, distinct from the Missal in which the prayers and antiphons are printed. Its Praenotanda state the principles governing the selection and arrangement of the readings, including the three-year Sunday cycle, the two-year weekday first-reading cycle, and the criteria of length, difficulty and omission.
